moments.label: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

points: Whatsoever pleaseth him I will do speedily, and it shall be my joy unto the day of my death. She said it to a heathen, but it is the state of mind a sister is supposed to have toward her husband.
Whatever you say, I am going to do it, and I am going to do it joyfully, until I die. That is what they them Christians mean by till death do us part; this is what it really is.
That is the way women thought back then. Their job was to serve their husbands, and that is what it means that Eve was a help meet.
